harness: Original cable included with Waveshare 19192; shortened at its jumper end
board_connection: Direct soldered through J6; optional 2.54mm male header NOT populated
housing: Original PH2.0 8-pin display plug retained; side entry parallel to screen PCB
wire: Original included wires; no replacement wire or crimp contacts purchased
manufacturer_bend_radius: Unpublished; static bends are user-authorized engineering approximations, not supplier ratings
trim_instruction: Trial-route supplied lead with its plug mated sideways before lowering the screen. Trim each wire to its actual dressed path, leaving assembly slack, plus 2.55mm stripped board end; solder tails <=0.8mm below PCB. Keep the original PH display plug.
screen_pose: 180deg about Y from official STEP, plus Z17.75mm; tab points -X

mating.insertion_axis: -X toward socket, parallel to display PCB
mating.seating_status: Side-entry inferred from supplied photo and official stepped 20x6x5.6mm socket envelope. Seated reach/axis estimated using JST PH side-entry 9.6mm mated depth; exact Waveshare connector manufacturer, contacts and mating cavity are not supplied. Check actual kit fit before final trimming.

scope: Cable type and 20cm package length verified on Waveshare product page/photo. PHR-8 nominal envelope from JST PH drawing; Waveshare does not specify the exact connector maker or seated plug datum. Mating axis/seating, wire OD and static bends use explicit engineering estimates. The nominal model is 1.2mm OD; larger 1.5mm wire clearance is checked separately.
